landing.faq.1.a: Yes, with a small server installed in the hotel. It keeps the front desk, cashier and restaurant running and syncs with the cloud as soon as the connection is back.
landing.faq.2.a: Yes. Every group and hotel is isolated, and each employee can only open the pages allowed for their job.
landing.faq.2.q: Is my data separated from other hotels' data?
landing.faq.3.a: The chart of accounts is revised SYSCOHADA, with VAT and tourist tax. Your chartered accountant must validate the settings before going live.
landing.faq.3.q: Does the accounting follow local rules?
landing.faq.4.a: MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money are built in. You need your merchant keys; until then everything runs in test mode.
landing.faq.5.a: The setup wizard lets a small hotel start in a day. Allow more if you are bringing across a lot of data.
landing.faq.5.q: How long does it take to start?
landing.faq.6.a: Yes. The online demo offers an account for each job so you can see what each person sees.
